A '''base''' was established by [[X1]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], where he practiced his [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] experiments. It was later overrun by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. At some point, [[X2]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Grey Squadron]] [[Mission to Dathomir (Galactic Civil War)|raided]] the base.
